mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces the discount rate applied to future cash flows, increasing the present value of expected equity returns and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for 3 consecutive months signals weak domestic demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakness periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 236 for 3 consecutive months indicates disinflation, reducing policy rate cuts and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% for 3 consecutive months signals a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 236 for 3 consecutive months signals a strong demand environment, increasing wage growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
